components.name: Lithium-Ion Traction Battery Pack
components.reasoning: This is the core energy storage system of an BEV and is always procured as a separate unit with its own distinct supply chain.

components.name: Battery Management System (BMS)
components.reasoning: The BMS monitors and controls battery performance, safety, and charging, ensuring reliable operation; it is typically a separate module in the BEV.

components.name: Lithium-Ion Cells
components.reasoning: These cells are the basic energy storage elements within the battery pack, forming the primary energy source for the vehicle's electric drive system.

components.name: Cooling System (Liquid or Air-Based)
components.reasoning: The cooling system regulates cell temperature to enhance performance and safety, often a distinct subassembly with its own suppliers.

components.name: Connector Assemblies
components.reasoning: These assemblies connect the battery pack to other vehicle systems like the motor controller and charging interface.

components.name: Mounting Structures (Frame)
components.reasoning: Structural components that secure and support the battery pack within the vehicle body, often a distinct assembly for ease of installation and protection considerations.

components.name: Electronic Control Unit (ECU) for Battery Management
components.reasoning: This unit coordinates communication between the BMS, motor controller, and other vehicle systems, integral to overall performance and safety.

components.name: Protective Housing/Enclosure
components.reasoning: The outer shell protects the battery cells from physical damage and environmental factors; often a separate component for design flexibility and protection considerations.

components.name: Current Transformers (CTs) / Isolators
components.reasoning: These devices measure real-time current flow, which is crucial for balancing and managing charge/supply processes within the battery pack.

components.name: Thermal Sensors
components.reasoning: Sensors monitor cell temperature during operation to prevent overheating and ensure efficient thermal management.

components.name: Voltage Distributor Boards (VDB)
components.reasoning: These boards distribute voltage evenly across battery cells, enhancing performance and balancing charge cycles between individual cells.

components.name: Fire Suppression System
components.reasoning: Designed to reactively address thermal runaway scenarios, a distinct system with specific suppliers, although often integrated within the battery pack assembly.
